svg.title: DiffusionAD 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它把正常表示成與新輸入何時值得回看；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 同樣的 AOI 問題，方法可能把正常表示成不同東西；先分清它在比較什麼，再比較結果。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

g.data-semantic-relation: produce a bounded generated or restored candidate
g.data-must-show: DiffusionAD：norm-guided one-step restoration 加 segmentation state | candidate output: joint input/restoration segmentation map 高 | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: DiffusionAD output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: DiffusionAD：norm-guided one-step restoration 加 segmentation state
